svg.title: GamingMaster: three layers by decision latency
svg.desc: A game is routed by how long one decision may take. Layer 1: Astra reasons through a generated harness on turn-based games. Layer 2: Astra plans asynchronously while Jev makes typed choices every tick through a generated harness. Layer 3: a trained multi-game network with a shared core acts every frame. The Meta-Harness builds layers 1 and 2; layer 3 is trained by joint imitation learning then mixed-game reinforcement learning.
svg.text: How long may one decision take before the game punishes it?
real time: the clock never pauses
one trained network, one forward per frame
the core is shared by every game
a coding model writes, tests and improves the harness program
